title: Input schema for Reddit scraper Lite
description: Scrape information about posts, communities and users https://www.reddit.com without login.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: If you already have URL(s) of page(s) you wish to scrape, you can set them here. If you want to use the search field below, remove all startUrls here.

skipComments.title: Skip comments
skipComments.description: This will skip scrapping comments when going through posts

skipUserPosts.title: Skip user posts
skipUserPosts.description: This will skip scrapping user posts when going through user activity

skipCommunity.title: Skip community
skipCommunity.description: This will skip scrapping community info but will still get community posts if they were not skipped.

includeMediaLinks.title: Include media links, up votes and comment count
includeMediaLinks.description: This will include upVotes, upVoteRatio, imageUrls, videoUrls, and numberOfComments when scraping posts. Enabling this will use a more detailed extraction method, which may affect performance.

searches.title: Search Term
searches.description: Here you can provide a search query which will be used to search Reddit`s topics.
searches.sectionDescription: This fields will be used on the search and will be ignored when using startUrls

searchCommunityName.title: Community (optional)
searchCommunityName.description: If provided, the search will be performed only inside this community (e.g., 'programming').

ignoreStartUrls.title: Ignore start URLs
ignoreStartUrls.description: Mainly used as a fix for ignoring starUrl on Zapier

searchPosts.title: Search for posts
searchPosts.description: Will search for posts with the provided search

searchComments.title: Search for comments
searchComments.description: Will search for comments with the provided search

searchCommunities.title: Search for communities
searchCommunities.description: Will search for communities with the provided search

searchUsers.title: Search for users
searchUsers.description: Will search for users with the provided search

searchMedia.title: Search for media
searchMedia.description: Will search for media with the provided search

sort.title: Sort search
sort.description: Sort search by Relevance, Hot, Top, New or Comments

time.title: Filter by date (Posts only)
time.description: Filter posts by last hour, week, day, month or year

includeNSFW.title: Include NSFW content
includeNSFW.description: You can choose to include or exclude NSFW content from your search
includeNSFW.sectionDescription: Choose the types of results you want to include

maxItems.title: Maximum number of items to be saved
maxItems.description: The maximum number of items that will be saved in the dataset. If you are scrapping for Communities&Users, remember to consider that each category inside a community is saved as a separated item.

maxPostCount.title: Limit of posts scraped inside a single page
maxPostCount.description: The maximum number of posts that will be scraped for each Posts Page or Communities&Users URL

postDateLimit.title: Post date limit
postDateLimit.description: Use this value to only retrieve posts published after a specific date.

commentDateLimit.title: Comment date limit
commentDateLimit.description: Use this value to only retrieve comments published after a specific date inside a post.

maxComments.title: Limit of comments scraped inside a single page
maxComments.description: The maximum number of comments that will be scraped for each Comments Page. If you don't want to scrape comments you can set this to zero.

maxCommunitiesCount.title: Limit of `Communities`'s pages scraped
maxCommunitiesCount.description: The maximum number of `Communities`'s pages that will be scraped if your search or startUrl is a Communities type.

maxUserCount.title: Limit of `Users`'s pages scraped
maxUserCount.description: The maximum number of `Users`'s pages that will be scraped.

scrollTimeout.title: Page scroll timeout (seconds)
scrollTimeout.description: Set the timeout in seconds in which the page will stop scrolling down to load new items

navigationTimeout.title: Navigation timeout (seconds)
navigationTimeout.description: Set the navigation timeout in seconds for page loading

proxy.title: Proxy configuration
proxy.description: Either use Apify proxy, or provide your own proxy servers.
proxy.sectionDescription: All settings bellow are ignored on the Lite version. The Lite version of the actor does not require proxy settings and they will be ignored.
